note: Trap/door/chest entity defs (S6 encounter table). masked:true entities show as "?" in the replay log (see sim/combat.cjs maskLabel) until discovered.

entries.name: Frost Deadfall
entries.note: Small (1x1) footprint per S6: 'harder to find => SMALLER footprint'. hp:1 is nominal (a trap is discovery-only, not HP-race; a single detection-mode ray hit ends it as a find, not damage, per S2.2/S6.1).

entries.name: Rimefast Door (hidden)
entries.note: Stage 1 of the two-stage hidden-door chain (S6 table): detection stage. On discovery, stage2 (door_rimefast_stage2) becomes the active entity.

entries.name: Rimefast Door
entries.note: Stage 2 (unlock stage): once revealed, unlock-mode POs must reduce its HP to 0 before its OWN timeout_secs (measured from the moment stage1 was discovered) or the 'keyhole breaks' (forced end, no shortcut, run continues per S6 table).

entries.name: Frostbound Cache
entries.note: Placed at enemy-field CENTER per S6.2. No offensive skills (chests don't fight back); unlock-mode POs race its HP to 0 before timeout_secs for a reward roll (S8.4); on timeout, chest is lost with no penalty.
